name: Skip CFG on first step
plain: Drops the negative while sigma is above a percent threshold, saving a call in the first steps. Core fills the missing negative with zeros and still applies CFG, so those steps return the positive multiplied by the CFG scale unless CFG is 1.
math: σ > percent_to_sigma(p): conds[1] = None, so x̂_u = 0 and x̂ = w·x̂_c (single pass; equals x̂_c only at w=1). Chains an existing calc_cond_batch function.
label: from code

audit.note: guidance.py:456 sets conds[1]=None, and ComfyUI/comfy/samplers.py:235-240 and :354 then return zeros for that slot, so x̂_u=0, not x̂_c. samplers.py:592-597 still applies CFG and gives w·x̂_c, because :610-613 is the only place that handles cfg 1. It runs without CFG only at w=1.
